default/31751.htm.text: Mysterious Dark Knight: You've come at a bad time. Don't you know that curiosity killed the cat? If you value your life, get out of here quickly!

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/31751-0.text: Mysterious Dark Knight: You missed her, my friend! I came running when I sensed she was in danger, but she was already gone. The winged vermin wouldn't tell me where she was taken, so I had to use force!
Mysterious Dark Knight: Search the corpses, you're sure to find something.

Mysterious Dark Knight: Hmm... blonde hair. I'm not sure what that tells us, but I know how to find out. Find Witch Kalis in south Oren. She can use her spells to find out where she was taken. Tell her I sent you, she owes me a favor. I must do my own research here. Good luck, my friend.

Mysterious Dark Knight: Meet a witch named Kalis south of Oren. She owes me a favor, so she'll help us. She should be able to tell us where the person who lost that blonde hair is. Now, be on your way! I'll continue my research here. May capricious destiny have mercy on you, my young friend!
Mysterious Dark Knight: I don't know. It's hard to track these gangs. Maybe we can find a clue from the dead ones.
